api_key.description: If this value is not set in the configuration, you must set the TINES_API_KEY environment variable instead.

tenant.description: If this value is not set in the configuration, you must set the TINES_TENANT environment variable instead.

created_at.description: The ISO 8601 Timestamp representing date and time the Tines Resource was created.

description.description: A long-form description of the Tines Resource.

folder_id.description: The ID of folder where the Tines Resource will be located.

id.description: The Tines-generated identifier for this Tines Resource.

is_test.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the Tines Resource production or test value should be updated.

live_resource_id.description: Optional when updating a test Tines Resource value.

name.description: The name of the Tines Resource.

read_access.description: Controls who is allowed to use this Tines Resource (TEAM, GLOBAL, SPECIFIC_TEAMS). default: TEAM.

referencing_action_ids.description: A list of Action IDs in Tines Stories that reference this Tines Resource value. This Resource should not be removed if this is non-null.

shared_team_slugs.description: List of teams' slugs where this resource can be used. Required to set read_access to SPECIFIC_TEAMS.

slug.description: An underscored representation of the Tines Resource name.

team_id.description: The ID of Tines Team where this Tines Resource will be located.

test_resource.description: A JSON block representing the test version of this Tines Resource.

test_resource_enabled.description: A boolean value indicating whether the Tines Resource is enabled for using a test Tines Reesource value during non-production Story execution.

test_value.description: Contents of the test version of this Tines Resource as a JSON array, object, or string.

updated_at.description: The ISO 8601 Timestamp representing date and time the Tines Resource was last updated.

user_id.description: The ID of user that created the Tines Resource.

value.description: Contents of the Tines Resource as a JSON array, object, or string.

block.description:
Tines Resources can be created with strings, arrays, or JSON objects as values. In general, Tines Resources should be used
for non-secret values that are reused repeatedly across Stories or Actions: e.g. things like domain names, references to
lists of users or IP addresses, etc. For secret values such as passwords and API keys, you should use Tines Credentials instead.
Throughout this documentation, we attempt to distinguish Tines Resources (which are stored in the Tines platform) from Terraform
Resources (which are stored in Terraform state files), although Tines Resources can be managed as a Terraform Resource.

change_control_enabled.description: Boolean flag indicating if change control is enabled.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 Timestamp representing date and time the story was created.

data.description: A local JSON file containing an exported Tines story. Setting this value can only be combined with the team_id and folder_id attributes.

description.description: A user-defined description of the story.

disabled.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the story is disabled from running.

edited_at.description: ISO 8601 Timestamp representing date and time the story was last logically updated.

entry_agent_id.description: The ID of the entry action for this story (action must be of type Webhook).

exit_agents.description: An Array of IDs describing exit actions for this story (actions must be message-only mode event transformation).

folder_id.description: The ID of the folder where this story should be organized. The folder ID must belong to the associated team that owns this story.

guid.description: The globally unique identifier of the story.

id.description: The Tines-generated identifier for this story.

keep_events_for.description: Defined event retention period in seconds.

locked.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the story is locked, preventing edits.

mode.description: The mode of the story (LIVE or TEST).

name.description: The name of the Tines story.

owners.description: List of user IDs that are listed as owners on the story.

priority.description: Boolean flag indicating whether story runs with high priority.

published.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the story is published.

send_to_story_access.description: Controls who is allowed to send to this story (TEAM, GLOBAL, SPECIFIC_TEAMS). default: TEAM.

send_to_story_access_source.description: Valid values are STS, STS_AND_WORKBENCH, WORKBENCH or OFF indicating where the Send to Story can be used.

send_to_story_enabled.description: Boolean flag indicating if Send to Story is enabled. If enabling Send to Story, the entry_agent_id and exit_agent_ids attributes must also be specified.

send_to_story_skill_use_requires_confirm.description: Boolean flag indicating whether Workbench should ask for confirmation before running this story.

shared_team_slugs.description: Array of team slugs that can send to this story. Required to set send_to_story_access to SPECIFIC_TEAMS.

slug.description: An underscored representation of the story name.

tags.description: An array of tag names to apply to the story.

team_id.description: The ID of the team that this story belongs to.

block.description:
A Tines Story resource can be managed either via a Story JSON export file, or by setting configuration values on the resource.
We recommend managing Stories via JSON export files if you rely on Terraform to manage change control for storyboard content. Otherwise, if
you use Tines' built-in Change Control feature, we recommend only enforcing configuration values via Terraform.
